note:
wagmi takes 1.4.2. One release is crossed, 1.4.1 to 1.4.2, and nothing is
skipped, so no skipped release carries a landing section anybody has to read.

The releases: class fix, disruption quiet. No core floor moves. Codex stays at
0.147.0 and Claude stays at 2.1.227, the same values 1.4.1 declared.

The box, measured on wagmi-claw at 18:41Z before this note was written:
claw-members holds two people. Both carry a persistent core, reading 2.1.252 and
2.1.227, and both meet the floor. No member reads as below a floor, so this
claw's own classifier will not defer the release to the quiet window.

1.4.2 lets a claw with no alarm webhook finish its apply. Under 1.4.1 the check
near the end of the run that renders the six alarm titles carried the notifier's
exit code out to the shell, and a claw with no channel wired stopped there. This
claw has a webhook, so it never met that fault and the fixed branch is not the
branch that runs here.

RESTART THE WAKE UNITS BY HAND AFTER THIS APPLY. An apply replaces
/opt/commonclaw/bin/bus-nudge and does not restart the units that run it, so
each account's wake rail keeps executing the bytes it started with. The two
fixes a member feels, the quieter journal and the presence test, do not reach
the running rail until somebody runs systemctl restart on every bus-nudge unit
or the box reboots. Measured on staging on 2026-09-02, where one unit held the
same process across two applies. The next release carries the installer fix.

What the quieter journal is worth here, measured before the apply: the wake unit
for the second member wrote 5,854 journal lines in the hour to 18:42Z, which is
88 percent of every line the machine logged in that hour. The other member's
unit wrote 13. After the apply and the hand restart, the first number should
fall to the same order as the second.

On a claw where anybody has left a tmux session behind, 1.4.2 moves the wake
rail onto tmux rather than into idle. The adapter ladder tries claude, then
codex, then tmux, so an account the claude adapter now reads as empty resolves
to a live tmux pane if one is there. That is the ladder working. It means the
idle state a reader expects may not appear. Neither member of this claw has a
tmux server today, measured at 18:41Z.
